newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-FALLON LOSES RIDES ON TOP CECIL DUO.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-FALLON LOSES RIDES ON TOP CECIL DUO.

text.p: Kieren Fallon. in his first season as stable jockey to the powerful Henry Cecil string, has paid the price for losing Saturday's Eclipse Stakes on hot favourite Bosra Sham.

Fallon was replaced on Lady Carla, another of the stable's star fillies, in a big race at Newmarket on Tuesday and will no longer ride either Bosra Sham or Lady Carla, who are both owned by Syrian businessman Wafic Said.
Fallon came under heavy fire from Cecil after getting himself boxed in in the five-runner field for Saturday's Eclipse Stakes and finishing only third.
But the Irishman will still ride the vast majority of Cecil's 200-strong stable and is a 5-2 third favourite to end the season as champion jockey.
Fallon has won two classics this year for Cecil but the rides on Bosra Sham, last year's Champion Stakes winner, and 1996 Oaks winner Lady Carla are expected to go to Pat Eddery.

Lady Carla raced in Tuesday's Princess of Wales's Stakes with Fallon switched to stable companion Dushyantor. But neither could hold 11-4 winner Shantou, the mount of Frankie Dettori, and both were well beaten.
But Fallon had struck earlier in the day, riding the first race winner -- for Cecil.
